violations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
violations.sample:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.37 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #16b8d4, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

violations.help: Document should have one main landmark
violations.sample:
Fix all of the following:

violations.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
violations.sample:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 2.41:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #16b8d4, surrounding text: #666666)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
